articles.title: pnpm 12.17
articles.summary: pnpm 12.17.0 adds pnpm peers check --global , dependency-group selectors and wildcards in overrides , and runtime, package manager, Cargo, and Python updates in pnpm outdated and pnpm update . It also fixes files that other users could not read in Docker images, and repeat installs that missed changes to local dependencies. Minor Changes pnpm peers check now accepts --global ( -g ) to check globally installed packages.
